sources.quote: Text tokens | Per 1M tokens | ∙ | Batch API price | Input | $1.10 | Cached input | $0.275 | Output | $4.40
sources.supports: OpenAI's model-specific pricing page lists the o4-mini standard input, cached input, and output rates as $1.10, $0.275, and $4.40 per million tokens. The catalog's prior cache rate of $0.28 differs from the published rate.

notes: The provider's current model page gives the same $0.275 cached-input rate as the post-change catalog value, indicating models.dev corrected its rounded $0.28 value rather than recording a provider price change. Internet Archive CDX was unavailable (HTTP 503), so no dated snapshot was obtained to establish when that correction occurred or independently bracket the historical period.
